changes: Reformer-only dependency made optional; supported adapters do not use it
FiLM: use registered CPU buffers and input-device allocation instead of a global CUDA device
TimesNet and MSGNet: exclude the FFT DC bin even when all amplitudes are zero
PatchTST, iTransformer, MSGNet, SCINet, TimeXer: out-of-place normalization and residual additions to permit gradients through preceding blocks
